correctness.rationale: Read RESULT.md, full verify_c8k3.py, exact frozen Git tree. The deterministic discrete Morse matching on all 18,721 nonempty independent faces is acyclic by topological sorting 18,721 Hasse nodes. It has one critical 0-cell, six 4-cells, eight 5-cells; displayed integral 6×8 Morse boundary has primitive left null row and a rank-five determinant-one minor. Five Smith factors are units, yielding H4=Z, H5=Z^3 with no torsion. Since the 5-cell attachments are in pi4(wedge six S4)=Z^6, unimodular cancellation gives S4 ∨3S5, not mere Betti inference. An explicit closed 66-four-simplex chain pairs -1 with integral cocycle, so symmetry generators act on primitive H4 by r=-1,s=-1,swap=-1,color3=+1. All 96 signed fixed-face Lefschetz traces yield H5 character (-1)^a(sgn(sigma)+fix(sigma)-1), exactly rho⊠(sign⊕U). In separate computation enumerated all 18,721 nonempty faces and independently calculated all 96 signed fixed-face Lefschetz traces, matching formula; finite exhaustive check is exact for this one finite complex, though did not independently rerun the 66-chain algorithm. Group-quotient rational homology is the invariant part after subdivision/averaging.
